## Motivation Follow-up to #30805 that fixes accuracy, enables all runtime features, and improves e2e perf by fusing/removing glue operations. ## Modifications Manages metadata in a native-way to the TRTLLM-gen attention kernel API (also more closely matching how TRT-LLM integrates the kernel). Modifications regarding runtime features like DP + MTP that interact with this particular kernel, are handled specifically to this backend - generic issues are addressed in separate PRs. ## Accuracy Tests GPQA: ```bash python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro \ --dsv4-attn-backend trtllm \ --trust-remote-code --tp 8 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 \ --chunked-prefill-size 4096 --disable-flashinfer-autotune \ --chat-template ./chat_template.jinja \ --mem-fraction-static 0.88 --max-running-requests 128 \ --host 127.0.0.1 --port 21000 ``` Eval: ```bash python3 -m sglang.test.run_eval --port 21000 --eval-name gpqa \ --num-examples 198 --max-tokens 120000 --repeat 8 \ --thinking-mode deepseek-v3 ``` flashmla (baseline, no MTP): ``` Repeat: 8, mean: 0.885 Scores: ['0.889', '0.879', '0.889', '0.879', '0.869', '0.899', '0.904', '0.874'] ``` trtllm_gen (same server command with --dsv4-attn-backend trtllm; same eval command): ``` Repeat: 8, mean: 0.907 Scores: ['0.919', '0.904', '0.894', '0.904', '0.909', '0.919', '0.904', '0.904'] ``` Extra stress testing: - DP4+MTP: GSM8K 0.975 - DP4+MTP stress: 128/128 requests; accepted length 1.99; no IMA - DP4 non-MTP: GSM8K 0.970 - DP4 non-MTP stress: 128/128 requests; no IMA - Focused metadata/output tests: 12 passed ## Tracing Traces show there are no extra "glue" kernels added (FlashMLA has splitKV + combine kernel, which is why it's total kernel count for the selected decode slice is 1 more), and we can confirm the individual kernel perf (in this case, ~13µs -> 10µs). FlashMLA: TRTLLM-Gen: ## Speed Tests and Profiling
V4-Pro Perf Commands 8x B200, TP8, `--dsv4-attn-backend flashmla` vs `trtllm`, both backends on the same node. ```bash # Prefill-only throughput server (cookbook low-latency cell minus EAGLE, + --max-running-requests 512) python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro --trust-remote-code \ --tp 8 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --disable-flashinfer-autotune \ --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --mem-fraction-static 0.90 --max-running-requests 512 --dsv4-attn-backend # Prefill-only bench (osl 1; ISL 8k / 32k / 128k with ratio 1, or 8k-32k with ratio 0.25) python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 --dataset-name random \ --random-input-len --random-output-len 1 --random-range-ratio \ --num-prompts <~16M tokens / ISL, at least 2x conc> --max-concurrency \ --warmup-requests --flush-cache # Decode servers (cookbook cells minus speculative decoding) # S1, low-latency (conc 1, 32): --tp 8 --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --disable-flashinfer-autotune \ --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --mem-fraction-static 0.90 # S2, balanced (conc 512), env SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=4096: --tp 8 --dp 8 --enable-dp-attention --moe-a2a-backend megamoe --chunked-prefill-size 32768 \ --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --mem-fraction-static 0.92 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 256 # S3, high-throughput (conc 2048, 4096), env SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=8320: --tp 8 --dp 8 --enable-dp-attention --moe-a2a-backend megamoe --mem-fraction-static 0.835 \ --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 544 --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.075 --chunked-prefill-size 65536 \ --tokenizer-worker-num 8 --enable-prefill-delayer # Decode bench (ISL 8192 / OSL 1024; N = max(3*conc, 64) up to conc 512, else 2*conc) python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 --dataset-name random \ --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 --random-range-ratio 1 \ --num-prompts --max-concurrency --warmup-requests --flush-cache ```
Performance, TP4 B200: Workload | TRT-LLM dense vs FlashMLA | --- | --- | Mixed 8K/1K, concurrency 32 | +4.1% total throughput Mixed workload mean TTFT |9.5% lower Pure prefill | +7.6% input throughput Pure prefill mean TTFT | 6.5% lower ### 2. Prefill-only throughput (V4-Pro, 8x B200 TP8, osl=1, cookbook low-latency flags minus EAGLE: mxfp4 MoE, chunk 8192, swa ratio 0.1, mem 0.90, max-running-requests 512, ~4.66M KV tokens) | ISL / conc | flashmla tok/s | trtllm tok/s | trtllm/flashmla | |---|---|---|---| | 8k / 1 | 26,231 - 27,441 | 29,642 - 30,029 | 1.09 - 1.13 | | 8k / 16 | 28,794 - 29,376 | 31,766 - 31,955 | 1.09 - 1.10 | | 32k / 4 | 27,696 - 27,903 | 30,780 - 31,000 | 1.11 | | 128k / 1 | 23,311 - 24,105 | 26,177 - 26,889 | 1.12 | ## 3. Decode (V4-Pro, 8x B200, ISL 8192 / OSL 1024, no spec decode) | server | conc | flashmla TPOT / out tok/s | trtllm TPOT / out tok/s | |---|---|---|---| | S1 TP8 (low-latency flags) | 1 | 9.47 ms / 103 | 9.04 ms / 108 (-4.5%) | | S1 TP8 | 32 | 19.73 ms / 1,308 | 19.02 ms / 1,369 (-3.6%) | | S2 TP8 DP8 megamoe (balanced flags) | 512 | 37.92 ms / 5,143 | 37.23 ms / 5,258 (-1.8%) | S3 TP8 DP8 high-throughput flags | 2048 | flashmla CRASHES | 59.17 ms / 4,027 | | S3 | 4096 | flashmla CRASHES | 58.14 ms / 4,163 | ## DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, `--dsv4-attn-backend trtllm`: main vs this PR 8x B200 node; every server on GPUs 0-3, one at a time, TP4 + EP4. main = 12004043b8, this PR = a4134b66bd. | | main | this PR | |---|---|---| | GSM8K-200 | 0.885 | 0.885 | | DSpark block 5: GSM8K-200 / accept length | 0.88 / 3.34-3.51 | 0.885 / 3.4-3.6 | | Prefill, 8k in / 1 out, concurrency 1: input tok/s (mean TTFT) | 53,268 (152.9 ms) | 54,592 (149.3 ms) | | Prefill, 8k in / 1 out, concurrency 16: input tok/s (mean TTFT) | 67,774 (1810 ms) | 69,845 (1756 ms) | ```bash # Server (cookbook B200 high-throughput cell + trtllm flags) python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --trust-remote-code \ --tp 4 --ep-size 4 --max-running-requests 256 \ --dsv4-attn-backend trtllm --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled # DSpark server (cookbook B200 low-latency cell + trtllm flags); accept length read from the server log python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --trust-remote-code \ --tp 4 --ep-size 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 \ --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \ --dsv4-attn-backend trtllm --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled # Accuracy python -c "from types import SimpleNamespace; from sglang.test.run_eval import run_eval; \ print(run_eval(SimpleNamespace(base_url='http://127.0.0.1:30000', model='deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash', \ eval_name='gsm8k', api='completion', max_tokens=512, num_examples=200, num_threads=32))['score'])" # Prefill throughput (C=1, N=32; C=16, N=128) python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 --dataset-name random \ --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1 --random-range-ratio 1 \ --num-prompts N --max-concurrency C --warmup-requests 4 --flush-cache ``` ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #39205653882](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39205653882) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39205653894](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39205653894) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39205653929](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39205653929)

[by Claude Code] **Severity: perf | Confidence: High**

**Issue**
This change makes the earlier `p_c128` memory concern (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36652#discussion_r4144572150) larger. `p_c128` is now allocated at startup with `max_prefill_rows` rows at full-context width. `_trtllm_query_row_capacity` includes `--max-prefill-tokens` (default 16384), so a smaller `--chunked-prefill-size` does not shrink it. The KV pool is sized before this runs, so the memory comes out of activation headroom.

**Example**
With a 1M context, each row is ~8.4K int32 (~33.8 KB). 16384 rows hold ~554 MB per rank on every server, even with `--chunked-prefill-size 4096`. The old lazy parent grew only to the largest chunk (~138 MB at 4096 rows).

**Fix**
Keep `p_c128` lazy, and back it with flat storage viewed as `buf[: rows * width].view(rows, width)` with this chunk's `SWA_WINDOW + w128`.
